summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual and Special Meeting of Shareholders. The filing discloses a planned leadership transition: Randy V.J. Smallwood assumed the role of non-executive Chair, Haytham Hodaly became a Director, and George L. Brack became Lead Independent Director. All director nominees were elected, and the advisory Say-on-Pay resolution passed with 95.16% support. No other special-situation elements were announced. This is a board leadership event, not a routine ministerial filing.
